## Exam 3

## 1. load & tidy FacultySalaries_1995.csv and boxplot

```{r faculty-load-tidy-plot}
faculty_raw <- read_csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv")

faculty_tidy <- faculty_raw |>
  select(
    State, Tier,
    AvgAssistProfSalary,
    AvgAssocProfSalary,
    AvgFullProfSalary
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AvgAssistProfSalary, AvgAssocProfSalary, AvgFullProfSalary),
    names_to = "Rank",
    values_to = "Salary"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Rank = recode(
      Rank,
      "AvgAssistProfSalary" = "Assist",
      "AvgAssocProfSalary"  = "Assoc",
      "AvgFullProfSalary"   = "Full"
    ),
    Rank = factor(Rank, levels = c("Assist", "Assoc", "Full")),
    Tier = factor(Tier, levels = c("I", "IIA", "IIB"))
  )

ggplot(faculty_tidy,
       aes(x = Rank, y = Salary, fill = Rank)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Tier, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Rank", y = "Salary") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Assist" = "#F8766D",
               "Assoc"  = "#00BA38",
               "Full"   = "#619CFF")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

---

## 2. ANOVA model

```{r faculty-anova}
faculty_aov <- aov(Salary ~ State + Tier + Rank, data = faculty_tidy)
summary(faculty_aov)
```

## 3. load & tidy Juniper_Oils.csv

```{r juniper-load-tidy}
juniper_raw <- read_csv("Juniper_Oils.csv")

chem_cols <- c(
  "alpha-pinene","para-cymene","alpha-terpineol","cedr-9-ene",
  "alpha-cedrene","beta-cedrene","cis-thujopsene","alpha-himachalene",
  "beta-chamigrene","cuparene","compound 1","alpha-chamigrene",
  "widdrol","cedrol","beta-acorenol","alpha-acorenol",
  "gamma-eudesmol","beta-eudesmol","alpha-eudesmol",
  "cedr-8-en-13-ol","cedr-8-en-15-ol","compound 2","thujopsenal"
)

juniper_tidy <- juniper_raw |>
  select(YearsSinceBurn, all_of(chem_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(chem_cols),
    names_to = "ChemicalID",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  )
```

---

## 4. faceted plot of chemical concentrations

```{r juniper-plot}
ggplot(juniper_tidy,
       aes(x = YearsSinceBurn, y = Concentration)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  facet_wrap(~ ChemicalID, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Years Since Burn", y = "Concentration") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## 5. GLM and broom: significant chemicals

```{r juniper-glm}
juniper_glm <- glm(
  Concentration ~ ChemicalID * YearsSinceBurn,
  data = juniper_tidy
)

glm_tidy <- tidy(juniper_glm)

sig_terms <- glm_tidy |>
  filter(p.value < 0.05, term != "(Intercept)")

sig_terms
```
